page.overview:
Who is Calina Colman?

Calina Colman was a woman who ran a bakery on the planet Estarvera with her husband Ryden Colman. When the plague known as the Blight appeared on Estarvera, Calina, Ryden, and their children Shanna and Davet Colman tried to evacuate the planet. Although the family was unable to escape, they survived due to the Blight being stopped by the Jedi Order.
